staticHcu.source: SG-4 authenticated operation schedule / receipt calculator
staticHcu.additionalFheOperations: none; FHE.allowThis is ACL bookkeeping and not HCU-priced

repositoryInspection.envelopeResolution: The supplied minimum production envelope is locked as the SG-3 maximum supported envelope.

recommendedTypes.publicElapsed: uint64 (checked), then exact uint128 scalar cast for FHE.mul

widthDecisions.installedTicketApiVerdict: BLOCKED: installed FHE.sol lacks euint256 ordered comparison and public-scalar remainder

installedFheApi.encryptedOverflowPolicy: Fixed-width results are not exposed as checked arithmetic; SG-3 forbids reaching overflow and requires pre-operation widening and proven bounds.
installedFheApi.euint256Limitation: randEuint256 exists, but euint256 ordered comparison, multiplication, and public-scalar remainder overloads are absent.

rejectionSampling.zeroTotal: No draw, no candidate, and no modulo operation.
rejectionSampling.oneTotal: All candidates are valid and the accepted encrypted ticket is deterministically zero.
rejectionSampling.divisorOfDomainSize: REJECTION_LIMIT equals 2^w and is not representable in w bits; set encrypted VALID to true and compute encrypted remainder, with T=1 specialized to encrypted zero.
rejectionSampling.nonDivisor: REJECTION_LIMIT is at most 2^w - 1, is checked before uint128 conversion, VALID is FHE.lt(R, limit), and ticket is FHE.rem(R, T).
rejectionSampling.confidentiality: R and accepted ticket remain encrypted forever; only T at the permitted draw stage and encrypted VALID may be publicly decrypted.
rejectionSampling.rerollRule: A valid candidate is immutable; exactly one replacement is allowed only after VALID decrypts false.

sequence: weightedDelta = widen(balance to euint128) * exact uint128(elapsed)
twabTransition.closeBehavior: Accrual is clamped to roundEnd; later updates add zero to closed-round TWAB.
twabTransition.aggregateProof: sum(user TWAB) = integral(sum(user balances)) dt <= MAX_POOL_BASE_UNITS * MAX_ROUND_DURATION_SECONDS, independent of participant count.

reopenConditions: time resolution changes from exact seconds
aggregate or prefix semantics exceed the pool-time integral bound
winner selection requires a domain larger than the aggregate TWAB
installed FHE arithmetic or casting semantics change
SG-4 cannot execute the required euint128 production path within accepted limits

architectureDecision.rule: smallest width that is mathematically TWAB-safe and has the complete unbiased encrypted ticket API
